cohort: 235 infants born at 34-35 weeks gestation and 470 term infants matched for gender and mode of delivery
finding: Infants born at 34-35 weeks gestation had a 13.3-fold increased risk of early morbidities compared to term infants, with jaundice, respiratory disease, and cyanotic episodes being the most common.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a modifiable factor associated with early morbidities in infants born at 34-35 weeks gestation.
